verdict.rationale: Several documented mechanisms give a lead control over versions. The CLI can be installed at a pinned version (ultrametric@0.4.1). `init` previews and then writes skill files that can be committed to share the setup with the team, so changes would arrive through version control. Process guides can be retrieved at a specific integer version. However, the docs never describe a lockfile or an explicit update policy, so the 'no silent updates' guarantee is only implied. missing for 10: an explicit lockfile or manifest pinning skill/process versions, documentation of how and when skill updates propagate (or are prevented from propagating), version pinning for the MCP connection path, independent hands-on corroboration.
